adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out both already-attending emails and `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), but the mutation response always returns `{ message: "Guests added" }` after adding only `uniqueGuests`, with no indication of which inputs were skipped. This matches the finding that a user can enter a blacklisted email, see the success toast (`showToast(t("guests_added"), "success")`), yet no attendee is created and no invite is sent for that blacklisted address. Additionally, when *all* inputs are filtered out, the handler throws `BAD_REQUEST` with message `"emails_must_be_unique_valid"`, which is misleading because the rejection can be due to blacklisting rather than invalid/non-unique emails.
